name: Observability / Reports / Incident Runtime
purpose: Give Kingsmen founder-grade visibility into system health, workflow progress, candidate pipeline load, incidents, capacity pressure, reports, delivery logs, and evidence-backed recovery actions.
locked_doctrine: Founder must see cause, reason, fix path, and evidence for incidents.
Reports inform the founder; reports do not bypass policy gates.
WhatsApp is urgent-only for critical incident escalation.
Oracle Lite monitoring must focus on cap, queue, memory, storage, workflow failure rate, and DB pressure.
Every incident must have severity, status, owner, evidence, timeline, and resolution notes.
Growth-cap readiness is measured by outcome quality, system health, and operational evidence.
Candidate privacy must be protected in reports.
